title: DO_SIGN/DO_VERIFY: update hash_algo to digest-algo-id semantics
description: Remove pre-hash path documentation from provider.h and ioctl.h. hash_algo is now the digest algorithm identifier (names the hash used to produce digest[]), not a request to hash. digest[] always contains a pre-computed digest.
close_reason: provider.h sign()/verify() contracts updated: hash_algo is digest algorithm identifier, not a request to hash; added 'The provider MUST NOT hash digest[]'. ioctl.h DO_SIGN/DO_VERIFY comments rewritten: removed pre-hash description, added 'caller is responsible for hashing', clarified hash_algo semantics for RSA DigestInfo.
